summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing Nasdaq's determination to delist its securities due to failure to regain compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(2) (minimum 400 shareholders). The company timely requested a hearing, staying suspension. Separately, Nasdaq approved transfer of listing from the Global Market to the Capital Market, effective July 29, 2026, with securities continuing under DTSQ, DTSQU, DTSQR. The delisting risk persists pending appeal outcome, with an additional separate basis for delisting cited. Watch for hearing results and potential Form 25-NSE filing.
